title: Is Tenerife warm in February?
author: Brogan
intro: Yes: the south of Tenerife is usually about 21 to 22°C by day in February, with plenty of sunshine, though the sea is cool and evenings need a jumper. Here's what to expect, where to stay for the best weather, and how February half term fits in.
seo_title: Is Tenerife warm in February? About 21-22°C by day
seo_description: Yes. The south of Tenerife is usually 21-22°C by day in February, with a 19°C sea and cooler evenings. Where to stay, what to pack and half term tips.

sections.heading: The short answer
sections.text:
- **Daytime high in the south:** about 21-22°C
- **Sea temperature:** about 19°C
- **Evenings:** about 15°C
- **Time difference:** none

February is one of Tenerife's best months for winter sun. It's warm enough for the beach and the pool on most days, but it's spring-like rather than hot, and the sea is bracing. Temperatures here are long-term averages, so expect some cooler, cloudier days too.

sections.heading: February weather at a glance
sections.text:
| | South coast (Los Cristianos, Costa Adeje) | North coast (Puerto de la Cruz) | Mount Teide |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Daytime high | about 21-22°C | about 19-20°C | often near freezing at the top |
| Rain | a few showery days | more cloud and showers | snow possible |
| Best for | beach and pool days | gardens, old towns, walking | the views, on a clear day |

The big difference is between north and south. The trade winds bring cloud to the north side of the island, while the south, sheltered by the mountains, is drier and sunnier. If warmth is the priority, stay in the south.

sections.heading: Is it warm enough to swim?
sections.text:
The Atlantic around Tenerife is about 19°C in February, its coolest time of year. Plenty of people swim, especially in sheltered bays like Playa de las Vistas in Los Cristianos, but it feels fresh, more like a British sea in August than the Med in summer.

Most hotels in the south have pools, and many heat at least one in winter. If a warm pool matters to you, check before you book rather than assuming it.

Tip: whale and dolphin trips run all year from Los Cristianos and Puerto Colón, because pilot whales live off the south-west coast. February's calmer days are a good time to go.

sections.heading: Where to stay in February
sections.text:
- **Costa Adeje and Playa de las Américas:** the most reliable sunshine, with lots of hotels and the resort feel.
- **Los Cristianos:** a working town as well as a resort, with a sheltered beach and the ferry to [La Gomera](/destinations/la-gomera).
- **Puerto de la Cruz:** greener and more traditional, but cooler and cloudier, so better for a walking or sightseeing trip than a beach week.
- **Santa Cruz:** the capital, best if you're going for carnival.

Our [Tenerife guide](/destinations/tenerife) covers the island month by month, and if you're still choosing an island, see [Gran Canaria or Tenerife](/blog/gran-canaria-or-tenerife) and [Madeira or Tenerife](/blog/madeira-or-tenerife).

sections.heading: Carnival and February half term
sections.text:
February is carnival month in Tenerife. The Santa Cruz carnival is one of the biggest in the world, with parades, music and street parties over about two weeks. The main parade is always on Shrove Tuesday, which in 2027 falls on 9 February. Check the official programme before booking, as dates are confirmed nearer the time.

Many English schools have February half term from 15 to 19 February 2027, though dates vary by area. That week is the most expensive of the month and flights sell out early, so book well ahead or go in early February instead. Hotels in Santa Cruz fill up during carnival, so many visitors stay in the south and take the bus or a taxi to the capital for the big nights.

sections.heading: What to pack
sections.text:
- **Light clothes** and swimwear for daytime in the south.
- **A jumper or light jacket** for evenings, which drop to about 15°C.
- **Warm layers, a hat and gloves** if you're going up Mount Teide, where it can be below freezing and snowy at the top.
- **Sun cream:** the sun is much stronger than at home, even in February.

Watch out: if you plan to take the Teide cable car, book ahead and check on the day. It closes in strong winds or icy conditions, which are more common in winter.

sections.heading: Where else is warm in February?
sections.text:
Tenerife is about four hours from most UK airports, with no time difference. If you want something different, [Lanzarote](/destinations/lanzarote) and [Gran Canaria](/destinations/gran-canaria) are similar, [Madeira](/destinations/madeira) is a little cooler and greener, and Egypt and [Cape Verde](/destinations/cape-verde) are warmer but further. Our [where to go in February](/destinations/where-to-go-in-february) and [February half term](/destinations/february-half-term-holidays) pages compare them.

If everyone wants somewhere different, add the options to somewhere.party and let the draw decide.

faqs.question: Is Tenerife hot in February?
faqs.answer: Warm rather than hot. The south is usually about 21 to 22°C by day, with cooler evenings of about 15°C.

faqs.question: Can you swim in the sea in Tenerife in February?
faqs.answer: Yes, but it's fresh, at about 19°C. Many people swim in sheltered bays, and many hotels heat their pools in winter.

faqs.question: Which part of Tenerife is warmest in February?
faqs.answer: The south, around Los Cristianos, Playa de las Américas and Costa Adeje. It's drier and sunnier than the cloudier north.

faqs.question: When is Tenerife carnival in 2027?
faqs.answer: The Santa Cruz carnival runs over about two weeks in February, with the main parade on Shrove Tuesday, 9 February 2027. Check the official programme for confirmed dates.
